reviews.author: Hyun young Jeong
reviews.text:
One of the best French restaurants in terms of overall score

☆Taste

Good taste. The most delicious thing in particular is the appetizer. Totally my taste. I think they made the charcuterie themselves (I haven't confirmed it), but it's very nice that it's presented neatly. But the best appetizer is undoubtedly Rillete. Until 2017, they gave it to me by tearing it into small pieces, but in 2018, I gave it to them whole. But anyway, it tastes the same because it's just chopped pieces put together. It is a must-try dish as it is rich in both flavor and quantity, so much so that you can eat this as a main dish.

The lineup of main dishes often changes. The peeled lamb (offal) pasta was also delicious in 2017, but it disappeared in 2018. I don't know if it's a seasonal menu. Mustard grilled chicken, kanyang pasta, chicken ssaucer, bourguignon, etc. are all delicious... a cote is all good too.

Overall, the quantity is large.

☆Atmosphere and service

Due to recent remodeling, all of the semi-outdoor tables, which had been cumbersome, were replaced with indoor tables. All windy vinyl exteriors have been replaced with a strong one.

The interior has a homey atmosphere reminiscent of a French home-style restaurant. There are few bar seats.

The chef is a brother, and the servers change frequently, but are almost always French. They mainly speak French and English, but also speak Korean occasionally, but everyone is friendly. I like it if you know how to speak French.

I went there for my birthday and I want to go more often. Delicious always!!

I want to go again.

reviews.author: Minhan Cho
reviews.text:
I had a course menu that came with a drink, but there wasn't much difference in price compared to ordering each item separately. The portion size for each dish is so large that just ordering a main and an appetizer would be enough for two people. The course menu includes one appetizer, one side, one main, and two desserts.

The appetizer was duck meat rillettes. There were a few bone fragments, but they didn't smell much, and there was a lot of them. You can feel full just by refilling the bread.

I ordered cappelloni filled with spinach as a side, and the tomato sauce was refreshing and not heavy, so it went well with the main dish. As expected, it's a lot of food, so if you eat it alone, it's just a plate of pasta.

The main fish of the day is a type of flounder. Really 'deep-fried' potato wedges are served on the side. The flounder wasn't that big, but the quantity was still not small. The only menu item that was a bit disappointing was that it was simply fried fish sprinkled with lemon. I plan to try a different main next time.

Even desserts are plentiful. In the end, I couldn't eat it all and left it behind.

When you go to a French restaurant, you often feel that the portion size is small, but here, the portion size is quite large, regardless of whether it is 'home food made by a mother who is big in French families' or 'home food that is given as much as you love it'.

However, the people working in the kitchen and the servers are all foreigners and are not fluent in Korean. In particular, since there was only one server, I felt that it was not enough to cover the entire large hall, and since the server adheres to quite Western table manners, you need to be a little careful.

reviews.text:
Stylish interior and friendly staff welcome you as if you were at a restaurant in Spain.
✔️Spanish Club Itaewon Branch

After staying in Itaewon and coming here, I was contemplating whether to try foreign food, which I don't usually eat, and I remembered the paella I ate before, so I chose Spain.

I searched and found that a place called Spanish Club is famous in Itaewon, so I went there right away.

I went there around 12:30 and it was already full, but luckily I was able to get in because they said there was a reserved spot starting at 2:00.

📸
• Ciampignones Con Iberico 19,000KRW
• Bread 3,000KRW
• Berengena a la Plancha 15,500KRW
• Paella de Mariscos 39,000KRW
• Cola 5,000KRW

The interior is nice and there is a reasonable amount of noise combined with the sounds of guests talking.
And the delicious smell of ingredients being cooked together with the pleasant menu items made me feel like I was on a trip.

When I first walked in, there were no empty seats and there was a table reserved for 2pm, so when I asked if I wanted to eat,
As people who eat quickly, we thought, ‘1 and a half hours?’
Looking at the menu, it said that the paella cooking time starts immediately after ordering, so it takes about 40 minutes.

Still, I ate a generous meal and left before 1:50 without feeling rushed at all.

It was delicious and the atmosphere was nice, so we decided to go down and get some Spanish food, and when we looked, there was a Spanish club in Haeundae!

I searched a little more and found out that Garosu-gil is the main branch, and it used to be a chain store with up to 7 stores.
I go to Haeundae often, but I didn’t know..

I came here after trying to go to a restaurant in Itaewon that was only found in Itaewon. It was nice to know about a delicious Spanish restaurant that I could visit nearby as well.

The staff were all very friendly and it was a pleasant meal after visiting Seoul.

reviews.author: Eunju Wu
reviews.text:
A real handmade burger restaurant found in Hannam-dong!
I ordered the Downtowner set and the patty was thick and juicy. The beef patty was grilled right after ordering, so it was fresh. The outside was caramelized and the inside was medium, retaining the natural flavor of the meat. The bun was soft and brioche-style, so it supported the weight of the burger well👍
The avocado burger is creamy and soft with thick avocado slices. The patty juice and avocado were a fantastic combination!
Original Chicken Bites taste good on the outside! It's bite-sized, so it's easy to eat, and the seasoning is delicious. The French fries were also well-fried and crispy.
There were a lot of foreign customers. I think it's because it tastes like a traditional American burger. There was an English menu and the atmosphere was casual, so it was nice to enjoy it comfortably.
Because it's a handmade burger, there's a 10-15 minute wait, but it's worth the wait! When you're craving a burger in Hannam-dong, this is the answer😋

I took the dinner course for 180,000 won. You can change to Korean beef touple by adding 20,000 won. I thought about adding an add-on, but I didn't because I wanted to fully enjoy the taste of the meat.

The appetizer comes with some seafood that goes well with a glass of white wine. I especially liked the salty, umami flavor of the anchovy tartar.

Several sauces were provided to accompany the meat, but the meat tasted so good that it would be a waste to eat it with other sauces, so I simply dipped it in malted salt. Overall, it is crispy on the outside, warm and well-cooked on the inside, and has a savory and strong chew. Personally, I like the tenderloin the most and enjoyed it the most, but I also enjoy the unique cheese flavor of long-aged meat from the strips and sirloin.

The pot rice and dessert were also good as a finishing touch. The dried jujube slices on the Hongsi Panna Cotta went well with it.

It was nice that there were seven types of pot rice menus, including basic pot rice, truffle mushroom, semi-dried croaker, braised butter, seafood, raw anchovy, and octopus water parsley, so you could choose according to your taste or preference. Soup is provided as standard, and the side dishes are all presented neatly and neatly. The semi-dried croaker pot rice was seasoned probably because it contains fish roe, and when you eat it wrapped in seaweed, the flavor explodes in your mouth. There is no other healthy dish that is as delicious as pot rice with plenty of vegetables.

reviews.author: Yijin Kim (Jane)
reviews.text:
Visit in February 2024
-Roasted cauliflower: Delicious. Do it unconditionally. It is cooked well and is very delicious.
- Mexican Eggs Benedict: The unique hollandaise sauce was delicious, but the bread was tasteless. This muffin bread has a very fluffy texture, but it's a big mistake ㅠㅠ
- Bisque Shrimp Raw Noodle Pasta:
As for the fresh noodle pasta, Vongole was said to be similar to kalguksu, so I chose Bisque Shrimp, and I liked how it had a good balance of tomato flavor and bisque flavor. The taste is not unique to melted bisque. As time passes, the noodles swell more and become like kalguksu. I think it would be good if it changed. I realized that this is why vongole is called kalguksu (noodle soup).

Visit in November 2024
- Soy Milk Cream Shrimp Fresh Noodle Pasta: Delicious. I was nervous because it was soy milk, but it was so nutty and light that my nervousness was in vain. It was delicious, and I didn't feel any discomfort. Because the noodles are wide, as time passes, the soy milk cream cools down and sticks to the noodles, allowing you to enjoy it even more.
- Grilled Squid & Butter Garlic Rice:
The texture of the rice grains was good and the taste was decent. If you eat it with a squeeze of lemon juice, you can enjoy it more with the combination of butter and lemon. However, the squid was tougher than I expected. So I had to ask for scissors separately. It is difficult to cut with a knife.
- Vietnamese Grilled Pork Noodle Salad:
I guess...they tend to hang out a bit separately, and it feels like bun cha? bun bo sao?, but you don't have to eat here. It's a good dish to order if you're on a diet. It was 21,000 won, but it would have been better if it had been 19,000 won.
-Salted Gourmet Butter French Toast: Delicious. I made soft and moist brioche bread with just enough egg water.

After selecting a menu, go directly to the counter and pay in advance. There is a waiting room inside the entrance, where small items are sold. reviews.text:
I went for lunch on a weekend and there was a bit of a wait. About 15 minutes? I felt like I was in Australia because there were authentic Australian brunch menus and desserts. Moreover, the fact that it opens at 7:30 a.m. is like an Australian cafe.

Croissant French Toast: French toast made by pressing croissants. Toppings include various berries, syrup, nuts, and bananas, and there is also bacon in between. It was sweet and delicious. The taste is predictable, but Pto is always right.

Salmon Waffle Eggs Benedict: It's hearty with salmon, avocado, and poached eggs. However, the waffle bread was not crispy and felt like soft white bread. And overall, it tasted healthy and not spicy. It felt a little different from the spicy American-style waffles.

Avocado Banana Smoothie: It tastes really healthy. The taste is so...

Pavlova: Australia’s representative dessert. It's a large meringue, and the middle part is soft like a marshmallow. They put whipped cream, raspberries, and passion fruit on top, and the whipped cream was really delicious. The whipped cream isn't that sweet, it tastes like milk, and it seems to have a bit of cheese in it. The dessert was a little sweet.
The food here seems to be either completely healthy or completely sweet.

reviews.text: I stopped by around 3 for a late Sunday brunch. There was no wait, but the place was full. There were 6-7 narrow tables inside and 2 tables on the terrace. I saw that there were small dogs in the outdoor space, so it seemed like a place where dogs could go. Three people ordered the grilled cheese + mushroom cream soup set, salmon poke bowl, root avocado roll, and coffee. The food came out quickly, and all you had to do was bring the cutlery and water you needed from the self-serve section and eat. The food tasted ordinary. Although the ingredients are fresh, the taste is all as expected. There was no special feeling. It was delicious to eat grilled cheese dipped in mushroom cream soup. There is a sauce you can dip the avocado roll with, but you had to dip about 2/3 of it to get the full flavor. My seat was outside on the terrace with chairs and a table inside, but they suddenly closed the door next to me without asking for my understanding, and while I was chatting while leisurely eating brunch, the kitchen looked at me as if I was being noticed. It didn't seem very friendly.

reviews.author: Jiyoon Moon
reviews.text:
I brought my family, friends, and even my favorite teacher to Alt A, and everyone absolutely loved it! They were amazed that vegan food could be such a delicious experience. Normally, when I eat regular Chinese food, I feel heavy and bloated all day, but here it’s vegan so my stomach feels comfortable—and I can enjoy eating even more.

The ultimate combo is the Eggplant in Fishbowl Sauce + Fried Rice 😭 Please, you have to order this! When you eat it with the sauce, it’s pure heaven. Adding the Harbin dumplings to the mix makes it even better. The Enoki Mushrooms with Soy Sauce were also fantastic, and the Cilantro Highball really refreshes your palate.

It’s also a great place for company dinners or group gatherings. The staff are so friendly and all speak fluent English, so it’s really convenient for foreigners—and I’ve noticed a lot of international guests here as well.

The Soybean Paste Jajangmyeon doesn’t have that unpleasant fermented smell—it’s more of a clean tofu and bean flavor, and it stays refreshing until the very last bite. I’ll definitely be coming back!

I brought a lot of people to Alt-A, including my family, friends, and favorite teachers, and everyone loved it and was amazed that they could have such a delicious experience as a vegan! Rather, if I just eat Chinese food, I feel bloated all day, but since this is vegan, it's convenient and I can eat more. The honey combination is... Fishbowl eggplant + fried rice ㅠㅠ Really, please make sure to order it. If you eat it with the sauce, it’s paradise. Plus, even Harbin… The Yurin top is really delicious and the cilantro highball also cleanses the mouth. It's great for company dinners or group gatherings!! The staff are friendly and everyone is fluent in English, so it seems easy for foreigners to come, and in fact, many foreigners come here!! Soybean paste jjajang does not smell like dried beans, but rather has the taste of tofu and beans, and it leaves your mouth feeling refreshed until you finish eating it! I will come again next time!! If the day is nice, I highly recommend eating on the terrace.

I've only seen a lot of Korean and Western food when it comes to vegan food, but I've only occasionally come across vegan cookies, so I visited with half expectations and half doubt, wondering if it was possible to eat vegan Chinese food and whether it was possible, and whether it would taste good even if it was possible.

First of all, the atmosphere of the store was very nice.
The customer service was also friendly.
The most important food!
I ordered soybean paste jjajangmyeon, and it didn't have the thick and thick taste of soybean paste, but had just the right amount of sweet and salty flavor, with a hint of spiciness from the pepper. It was very delicious.

I don't know if it's because it's a vegan food, but it felt clean and light without any bloating or anything like that.

I thought vegan food was far from tasty, but at least here I was wrong.
I'm really curious about the other menus, so I'll have to look for them again.

This is a vegan restaurant with an exotic atmosphere. There were a lot of foreign customers and the staff seemed more comfortable speaking English. I think I would trust it in any cafe in LA.
I came for lunch on a weekend and there was a lot of waiting and I think I had to wait about 20-30 minutes. The entrance is small and the store is located on the second floor.
Overall, the portions are large and despite being vegan, it is delicious. Of all the things I ate, the Chipotle Chicken Bowl was the most delicious. It was the freshest and most unique taste in my opinion.
The vegan desserts look really delicious too, I definitely want to try them sometime in the future!!

Mushroom Burger: The patty is said to be a vegetable patty, but it tasted like soybean meat and was delicious.

Chipotle Chicken Bowl: Very filling and has a variety of toppings. It had an exotic taste because there were many ingredients that could be found in a somewhat Mexican dish.

Rigatoni Pomodoro Pasta: The quantity is very large compared to regular pasta. Soybean meat was added to the rigatoni noodles. Since the portion is large, the noodles get dry quickly and the food gets cold. The sauce was sweet and delicious.

reviews.text: This is a restaurant and bakery located on the second floor behind Yongsan-gu Office in Itaewon. The small restaurant with four tables had a nice cafe-like interior. I liked the voluminous taste of Lasania, which was more American than European, created by combining rich ingredients. This is a good restaurant that I would like to visit again to buy bread when I come to Itaewon.

A sandwich with slightly spicy chorizo, chicken breast, Gruyere cheese, Greek yogurt, and olives. The bread was baguette. I wanted to buy a baguette, but I knew it wouldn't have the same texture if I bought it, so I decided to just be satisfied with it. reviews.author: Ga young Bae
reviews.text: I stopped by here because my friend said he wanted to try the corn crumble cheesecake. They asked me to be very quiet from the time I entered, and I was only able to enter after hearing an explanation of the 1 hour and 20 minute time limit and signing a confirmation. We went around lunchtime on a weekday and the place was spacious. I ordered corn crumble cheesecake and warm Americano, and when my number was called, I could go find drinks and bakery items. Cake usually costs 9,000 won per piece. Coffee wasn't cheap either. A cheesecake with a cone inside was served with crumbles and condensed milk sprinkled on top. The hard cheese, corn, and crumbles gave it a great texture, so it was fun to chew and had a deep cheese flavor, which didn't seem like a good match, but it went well. The coffee taste wasn't bad, and it didn't have any acidity and had a heavy taste, so it went well with the cake. I was able to drink all my coffee and pour water into my self-serve water, but they said I had to buy a separate cup if I didn't want to do that. They were kind, and the taste wasn't bad, but there were too many restrictions. When I go to a cafe, I can't really chat with my friends, and I have to just watch what others think and leave on time. I don't think I'll go back unless I have a sweet tooth. When ordering a whole cake, you must place your order 3 days in advance to receive it.

It is a wonderful “bakery cafe” with a cozy atmosphere.

The food and drinks are great and there is free wifi.

The cafe is quiet and spacious, which is the main reason I come often.
It's not a good idea for the tables to be too close together.

I read that some people wrote that the staff here are unfriendly, but I honestly couldn't confirm that. The employees may be a bit “remote” by Korean standards. But as someone like me who grew up in Europe, I value discretion and feel uncomfortable when strangers are “too friendly.”

Please keep in mind that this store is located in Itaewon. So meeting foreigners is not something special for the people of Itaewon.

I don't expect any special kindness. The employees do their jobs, sometimes spending hours on their laptops and smartphones, but it doesn't bother me. So we're both happy with that.

I also appreciate that they have separate "Halal" options listed in Arabic and English for the local Muslim community and tourists.
I think this is a very “inclusive” action that embraces Korea’s increasingly diverse and international modern society.
And I'm glad to see this trend in my hometown, which has long been a very homogenous ethnic community.

Perhaps it's because the store is located 5-10 minutes from Seoul's largest mosque and in one of Korea's most cosmopolitan areas.

reviews.author: B K
reviews.text:
This place is famous for its Turkiye dessert shop.
They also sell Turkic style sand coffee, but only a small cup like espresso is served.
The taste is very strong, but different from espresso. While espresso is extracted by filtering at high temperature and pressure, this coffee is heated(?) by pouring water over hot sand just like the ground coffee particles, so the particles remain at the bottom. Therefore, if you drink even those particles, it may feel a bit unpleasant. Over time, the particles settle at the bottom, so if you just drink the top part, the rich coffee taste is very good.
For dessert, I usually eat kaymak or baklava when I come here.
Personally, I recommend Kunapa.
People simply think of the filling of Dubai chocolate as Kadayif, but in fact, the first person to make it was not simply Kadaiif, but was inspired by Kunapa.
When making kunapa, they put goat's milk cheese in thin dough, bake it, soak it in sweet syrup, and sprinkle pistachio powder on top.
The taste I felt was more like a thin noodle with a savory and crispy texture on the outside rather than goat milk cheese, and the inside was moist with sweet syrup and lightly finished with pistachio powder, giving it a unique taste and scent.
It goes quite well with coffee, so try it if you like sweet desserts (but it takes time to cook, so you may have to wait about 20 minutes).
